recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, minimalist composition featuring two figures in suits shaking hands against a deep black void, framed by a wide white border. One figure is engulfed in realistic, bright orange flames that trail behind them, while the other remains unaffected.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the two standing figures
Extreme contrast between the dark void and the bright fire
Isolation of the subject within a large white border
Tension between the calm handshake and the destructive fire
coreInvariants: Deep black background with subtle floor reflection
Realistic fire texture with sparks and embers
Formal business attire on both subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered horizontally and vertically within the black frame, scaled to occupy the middle third of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point of contact (the handshake) serves as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright flames on the left, follows the arm to the handshake, and rests on the calm figure on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of negative space both in the black void and the white outer margin to create a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (background and suits) providing depth and void.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (outer border) providing a clean, gallery-like frame.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Orange and Yellow (fire) providing the only warm light source.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the fire/border and the background; low saturation except for the fire.
paletteRestrictions: Fiery warm tones only for the effect

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the bottom white margin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for utilitarian labeling.

avoid: Placing text over the central image

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy feel of standard advisory labels.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic shot of two men in dark suits shaking hands in a pitch-black void. The man on the left is engulfed in realistic, intense orange flames that lick upwards and trail behind his back. The floor has a subtle, dark reflection. Place this entire image inside a large, square white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, centered, black-and-white rectangular advisory label in the bottom white margin using a bold, condensed sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the fire texture realistic and not illustrative?
Is the background pure black without environmental details?
Is the white border perfectly uniform on all sides?
Is the text restricted to the bottom margin?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact wording of the advisory label

mustAchieve: Clean separation between the black image and white border

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the fire does not overlap the figure on the right.
Check that the white border is not cropped.
Verify the subjects are perfectly centered.
Confirm the lighting on the figures matches the light emitted by the fire.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central surreal interaction + dark void environment + wide white gallery frame + minimalist bottom-centered typography.
